text:
sam: quick heads-up — ran a focused microbench on the paged-flash variant (paged-flashv2-fuse) on A100-80GB. seeing lane saturation: DRAM bandwidth plateaus ~680 GB/s and tokens/sec doesn't scale with batch > 8.

anya: can you paste the ncu output and exact kernel/config? which model+seq?

sam: model=llama-13b, seq=1024, kv_cache=on, kv_prefetch=sync. kernel=paged-flashv2-fuse, tile_w=128, pipeline_stages=2. ncu snippet:```
DRAM BW: 680.2 GB/s
L2 BW: 1.22 TB/s
SM occupancy: 62%
Avg SM eff: 45%
Tokens/s: 72k
```

lee: 680GB/s is suspiciously consistent with a lane packing issue. sounds like all lanes converge to same mem-wall. try halving tile_w and add a 3rd pipeline stage so smem can be reused across smaller tiles.

mike: also try async kv prefetcher + smaller prefetch window. batching heuristic might be overfilling lanes — reduce max_batch_tokens or use adaptive_batching.

sam: ran a quick try: tile_w=64 pipeline_stages=3 kv_prefetch=async kv_prefetch_window=3. result: DRAM BW jumped to 821 GB/s, tokens/s +12% (80.6k) but p99 latency jitter +6ms, smem spill counters increased.

anya: can you share the perf counters for smem spills / local memory? also rerun with prefix warmup (prefix=128) to rule out cold kv miss storm.

sam: smem_spill_incidents: 18/min (was 2/min). local_mem_reads up ~1.4x. reran with prefix=128 + warmup ramp (10 iters): BW 790 GB/s, tokens/s 78.9k, spill incidents down to 6/min.

lee: that matches expectation — smaller tiles increase concurrency but raise per-thread register pressure causing spills unless we pipeline more. we should try: tile_w=64, pipeline_stages=4, register_alloc_hint=low. add a crosswarp_coalesce pass in kernel selection for seq>=512.

mike: I'll add a temp selector weight so paged-flashv2-fuse favors the smaller-tile kernel for seq>=512 on A100. we should also test on V100 and H100.

perf-bot: regression-alert: PR #4321 adjusted kernel-selector weights last week — flagged as potential root cause. linked CI: https://ci.redwood/4321.

sam: re-run with lee's pipeline_stages=4 + reg_alloc_hint=low -> DRAM BW 845 GB/s, tokens/s 84.1k, p99 improved vs previous try but tail still +3ms over baseline. smem spill incidents ~3/min.

anya: nice. next steps: 1) add the smaller-tile kernel path + pipeline_stages tuning to canary config, 2) run cross-hardware sweep (A100/H100/V100), 3) instrument kv-prefetch async window tradeoffs (0-6) and batching thresholds.

mike: scheduling the canary on dedicated pool this afternoon. @sam can you own the perf-run and collect a small benchmark matrix (tile_w 64/96/128 x pipeline 2/3/4 x kv_prefetch_window 0/3/6)?

sam: on it — will push results here and attach perf traces.

perf-bot: perf-run queued: id=78234 target=dedicated-a100 estimated=45m link=https://perf.redwood/78234 :rocket:

lee: one more note — add an eviction-safe fallback for extremely large batch spikes (max_lane_fill=0.85) to avoid total saturation. low-risk toggle for canary.

mike: added flag to canary config. good call. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — sharing traces + heatmaps once run finishes.
